neighbours.label: the vocabulary of Marxist class analysis (bourgeois, bourgeoisie, capitalist, feudal) used as historical-materialist categories, as against ordinary words for the same social groups (landlords, the rich, medieval, selfish)
fire: The pamphlet called on workers to rise against the bourgeoisie.
In his view, the capitalist mode of production would collapse.
Engels traced how feudal relations gave way to wage labour.
The party purged members accused of petty bourgeois attitudes.
Trotsky attacked the bourgeois democratic illusions of the liberals.
Mao described China as a semi-feudal and semi-colonial society.
The strike was crushed by the capitalist press and the police.
Workers of the world, unite against the bourgeois state!
quiet: The pamphlet called on workers to rise against the landlords.
In his view, the factory system would collapse.
Engels traced how medieval guilds gave way to wage labour.
The party purged members accused of selfish attitudes.
Trotsky attacked the naive democratic illusions of the liberals.
Mao described China as a poor and divided society.
The strike was crushed by the newspapers and the police.
Workers of the world, unite against the rich!
